title: Adapter registry and per-source options
description: Create adapters by source name with root and home overrides; unknown sources raise a clear error. Done when: registry tests pass for all five sources with option overrides.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: create_source(name, SourceOptions) in src/importer.rs registers all five sources (claude_code, cursor, codex, grok_bot, antigravity) with root override, home override, and /Users/example-derived default roots per source; unknown names return UnknownSource with a clear message listing the known sources. Unit tests cover all five sources, root/home overrides, and the unknown error; full gate green.

right_now_summary: The adapter registry supports all five sources, overrides, and clear errors for unknown names.
